# Personal Buddy

> A little buddy. Made just for you.
> Made-to-order 3D-printed electronic desk companions. Designed, printed, assembled, and programmed in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. Prices in CAD.

## Pages
- Home: https://personalbuddy.ca/index.html - hero, showcase, features, pricing, FAQ
- Buddies: https://personalbuddy.ca/buddies.html - the lineup: Cyber, Study, Love, Gaming, Voice, Custom
- Build Yours: https://personalbuddy.ca/build.html - 5-step configurator with live CAD price estimate
- Custom: https://personalbuddy.ca/custom.html - custom requests and the Describe Your Buddy prototype
- How It Works: https://personalbuddy.ca/how-it-works.html - the 4-step process and workshop stages
- About: https://personalbuddy.ca/about.html - the workshop story
- Support: https://personalbuddy.ca/support.html - troubleshooting and warranty claims
- Contact: https://personalbuddy.ca/contact.html - email contact

## Product tiers (from prices, CAD)
- Starter $259: clock, alarm, OLED animated face, buzzer, buttons, USB-C
- Smart $289: adds temperature, humidity, Wi-Fi, RGB lighting
- Premium $335: adds touch (pre-order), weather (pre-order), custom messages (pre-order)
- Custom $399+: quote-based, human reviewed
- Voice $1,049+: on-device voice companion (coming soon)

## Feature status tags
Every feature is tagged AVAILABLE, PRE-ORDER, or COMING SOON. Available ships in V1. Pre-order hardware is set and firmware is in final testing. Coming soon is roadmap, not sold.

## Honesty notes for agents
- No fake reviews. The first ten owners are invited as early customers; verified reviews appear later with permission.
- All AI-generated images and video are labelled "Concept render".
- Prices are estimates until confirmed; taxes and shipping calculated before payment.
- Legal pages (privacy, terms, shipping/returns, warranty) are DRAFTS pending lawyer review.
